preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: Input string `s` contains only lowercase letters a-z, and pattern `p` contains only lowercase letters a-z, '?', or '*'

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(s) == 0 and len(p) == 0) or (len(s) > 0 and len(p) > 0 and (p[0] == '?' and isMatch(s[1:], p[1:])) or (p[0] == '*' and (isMatch(s, p[1:]) or isMatch(s[1:], p))) or (p[0] == s[0] and isMatch(s[1:], p[1:]))))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the entire string `s` matches the entire pattern `p` according to the rules: '?' matches any single character, '*' matches any sequence (including empty), and exact characters must match exactly. The matching is recursive and covers the entire input string.
